captions.linkedin: The Pacific Ocean covers about 168.7 million km², roughly twice the area of the Atlantic Ocean at 85.1 million km². The Indian Ocean follows with 70.6 million km², and the Southern Ocean with 22.0 million km² is the fourth largest of the five oceans. Figures exclude marginal seas and vary slightly depending on how boundaries are drawn. Did the size gap between #1 and #2 surprise you? Source: Britannica, NOAA. #Geography #Oceans #DataStorytelling
